verdict.rationale: gstack distinguishes global from vendored installs and updates through an explicit /gstack-upgrade skill that shows what's new (gstack-docs-7). Community notes it installs by git-clone-and-copy (gstack-comm-3). Together these imply a team can vendor a fixed copy into the repo and choose when to upgrade, but this is inferred rather than documented as a team version-control feature. missing for 10: documented version pinning or lockfile, explicit guarantee of no automatic background updates, team-wide rollout controls, independent hands-on corroboration.
